title: Meeting Archbishop Marcinkus at the Vatican Bank

tellings.quote: and I and I looked up and he said we know about you from your boyhood with a lot of our associates in the mafia.

plain: In 1973 Harold Malmgren, a former advisor to US presidents, met Archbishop Paul Marcinkus, the churchman who ran the Vatican's bank, and was told the church already knew all about him. Malmgren tells it himself: the archbishop said, "we know about you from your boyhood with a lot of our associates in the mafia." He tells it to show how closely powerful hidden networks had followed him since childhood.
